UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Root identity document for all account sub-collections. Access is strictly controlled to the authenticated owner (UID match). Owners have full read, create, and update permissions.

WalletAsset.title: Wallet Asset
WalletAsset.description: Cryptographic vault document. The 'primary-vault' ID is reserved for the deterministic root wallet. Owners have full read/write access to their own assets sub-collection.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Private financial ledger for the authenticated user. Owners have full read and create access.

/users/{userId}.description: Root user document. Rules must allow 'create', 'get', and 'update' if request.auth.uid == userId.

/users/{userId}/assets/{assetId}.description: Owner-only access to vault endpoints. Rules must allow all operations if request.auth.uid == userId.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{txId}.description: Owner-only financial ledger. Rules must allow 'list', 'get', and 'create' if request.auth.uid == userId.
